en.title: Skinned characters in the Android World3D player
en.body: The GLES3 player animates opaque skinned meshes using resident geometry and shared bone palettes. The Snow Temple example uses the original Lin Chong model, material textures and spear moves.

zh.title: Android World3D 播放器支持蒙皮角色
zh.body: GLES3 播放器可复用驻留几何和共享骨骼矩阵，绘制不透明蒙皮角色。《风雪山神庙》示例接入了林冲原模型、材质贴图与长枪动作。
